purpose: To execute a deposit trust deed for appointing trustees for depositors before issuing a circular or advertisement inviting secured deposits.
who: A company referred to in sub-section (2) of section 73 or any eligible company.
when: At least seven days before issuing the circular or circular in the form of advertisement.
steps: Obtain written consent from the proposed trustee for depositors before their appointment.
Include a statement in the circular or advertisement showing that the trustees have given their consent to be appointed.
Execute the deposit trust deed in Form DPT-2 at least seven days before issuing the circular or advertisement.
checklist: Check that the proposed trustee is not a director, key managerial personnel, officer, employee, or depositor of the company or its related companies.
Verify that the proposed trustee is not indebted to the company or its related companies.
Verify that the proposed trustee does not have a material pecuniary relationship with the company.
Check that the proposed trustee has not entered into a guarantee arrangement for the deposit debts or interest.
Ensure the proposed trustee is not related to any directors, key managerial personnel, officers, or employees of the company.
watch: Do not appoint a person who is disqualified due to being an officer, employee, debtor, or having a pecuniary relationship with the company.
